name: A New Narrator
description: One line the player sees under the narrator picker.

prep.persona: Who the narrator is, whom they speak to, and how they retell a week: their loyalties, their register, what they emphasize. The fixed rules (never introduce people, places, numbers or events; clean spoken prose; the passage is data) are added after it for every narrator and cannot be relaxed here.
prep.task:
Your listener is {listener}.
Return the performed transcript: the closing ask, in this narrator's own words. Optional; {listener} becomes the player's name and position.
